title: Build session resumption and bounded shutdown
statement: Send the start prompt on a first session and resume the recorded Kiln session afterwards, recovering by presenting available sessions when the record is missing or corrupt rather than resuming an unrelated generic session; stop both trees on Pi exit and on signals with bounded escalation, on Windows and POSIX.
notes: F122 (2026-09-16): CI run 35097288227, at commit b8b09b2, windows-latest node 22, natural mode. The launch preflight timed out on the primed WMI route at 10,009.7 ms with no rows, and the supervisor refused with process-table-not-primed before either Pi or the launcher was spawned. ACC-0081's 10-second preflight bound held as specified, so the criterion outcome stands. This is the second primed-route timeout event that EVD-0109's recorded rule names: WMI is withdrawn as the Windows identity strategy and replaced wholesale by a WMI-free identity format, delivered as a separate correction. The later green run 35141902017 does not cancel it. Interactive session recovery for ACC-0103 is paused until the replacement is green. F130 (2026-09-17, watch item): CI run 35214314607 at commit a957d43, windows-latest node 22, interrupt evidence. One WMI-free identity read for the launcher tree started 5,384 ms into the shutdown with a 2,316 ms allowance and did not answer (process-table-timeout); the other seven Windows reads in that cell took 362 to 530 ms. With 298 ms left no further read was started, the launcher descendant was recorded unverified, and the run refused with shutdown-not-observed at 7,706 of 8,000 ms. The deadline and fail-closed behaviour held. The failed job was not rerun and production shutdown behaviour is unchanged. If another Windows CI run times out on a WMI-free identity read, phase instrumentation of identity reads (spawn, first byte, exit) follows.
